UserRecord.title: UserRecord
UserRecord.description: Authenticated user profile, live presence, ad impressions, purchase revenue, app usage time, and admin moderation flags.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

email.description: User Google email (PII, restricted to owner and allowed admins).

online.description: Whether user session is currently active.

drawingsCount.description: Total drawings saved by the user.

sessionsCount.description: Total app sessions opened by the user.

adsWatchedCount.description: Total ads watched by the user.

purchasesCount.description: Total completed in-app purchases by the user.

totalSpentCents.description: Total USD spent by the user in integer cents (e.g. 199 = $1.99).

totalUsageSeconds.description: Total foreground time spent using the app in seconds.

lastActiveAt.description: Server timestamp of latest user activity (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest document update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

UserActivityLog.title: UserActivityLog
UserActivityLog.description: Append-only user activity event stored under a user document.

action.description: Short action code such as SESSION_START, SAVE_DRAWING, AD_WATCHED, or PURCHASE.

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global remote configuration controlled exclusively by the allowed app admins.

maintenanceMode.description: Locks app for non-admin users when true.

announcementEnabled.description: Shows live announcement banner on Home.

arCameraEnabled.description: Enables or disables AR Camera drawing mode.

lightboxEnabled.description: Enables or disables Display Lightbox tracing mode.

bingSearchEnabled.description: Enables or disables online Microsoft Bing search.

storeEnabled.description: Enables or disables the Store tab.

updatedBy.description: Admin email who last updated config.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when config was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last config update.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles, live presence, ad impressions, purchases/USD spent, app usage duration, and admin moderation controls.

/users/{userId}/activity_logs/{logId}.description: Per-user append-only activity log entries for admin inspection.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Singleton remote app control configuration at /app_config/global.
